package.name: amr_sim
package.description: 2-D simulator for the AMR stack (C++/ROS 2 port of amr/sim): rasterized ground-truth world, differential-drive exact-arc kinematics, vectorized ray-cast lidar, footprint collision, and seeded noisy odometry. Library plus a thin sim_node that publishes /scan, /odom, /ground_truth and tf.
